title: A channel's provider_name is its provider's name, and none for a channel that has no provider
notes: Python: channels/base.py Channel.provider_name, channels/ai.py provider_name; roomkit-rs: roomkit channel.rs Channel::provider_name, roomkit-ai channel.rs. RK-6.1-016 is cited in part: the attribution the name serves (EventSource.provider) is not observed, the scripted agents' events naming no provider.
